not-torznab: The service at this address answered, but not with Torznab capabilities. Check that the address is the feed's Torznab URL.
not-search-results: The service at this address answered, but not with Torznab search results. Check that the address is the feed's Torznab URL.
not-found: Nothing answers Torznab at this address (404 Not Found). Use the feed's Torznab address: Prowlarr's ends in /api, and Jackett's Copy Torznab Feed gives one ending in /results/torznab/.
too-many-requests: The Torznab feed is refusing requests for now (429 Too Many Requests). Try again in a few minutes.

connected.no-search: Connected to {{server, vendor}} over Torznab, but it offers no movie or TV search.
connected.tv-only: Connected to {{server, vendor}} over Torznab, but it offers no movie search; TV search by {{tv, list:and:message}}.
connected.movie: Connected to {{server, vendor}} over Torznab; movie search by {{movie, list:and:message}}.
connected.movie-and-tv: Connected to {{server, vendor}} over Torznab; movie search by {{movie, list:and:message}}, TV search by {{tv, list:and:message}}.

connected-to-feed.no-search: Connected to the feed over Torznab, but it offers no movie or TV search.
connected-to-feed.tv-only: Connected to the feed over Torznab, but it offers no movie search; TV search by {{tv, list:and:message}}.
connected-to-feed.movie: Connected to the feed over Torznab; movie search by {{movie, list:and:message}}.
connected-to-feed.movie-and-tv: Connected to the feed over Torznab; movie search by {{movie, list:and:message}}, TV search by {{tv, list:and:message}}.

feed.refusing: The Torznab feed is refusing requests for now ({{error, message}}). Try again in a few minutes.
feed.key-refused: The Torznab feed refused the API key ({{error, message}}). Copy the API key from the dashboard of the service that serves this feed, such as Jackett or Prowlarr, into this integration under Integrations.
feed.key-refused-status: The Torznab feed refused the API key ({{status}}). Copy the API key from the dashboard of the service that serves this feed, such as Jackett or Prowlarr, into this integration under Integrations.
feed.api-off: The Torznab feed has its API switched off ({{error, message}}).
feed.wrong-indexer: The Torznab feed doesn't serve what this address names ({{error, message}}). Check the indexer in the feed's address, such as …/indexers/toloka/results/torznab/ for Jackett or …/1/api for Prowlarr.

search.not-understood: The Torznab feed didn't understand the search ({{error, message}}).
search.links-elsewhere: The Torznab feed lists its downloads at {{origin, vendor}}, not at the address entered for it, so the app couldn't fetch them. Enter the feed at the address its download links use.

download.not-a-torrent: The Torznab feed answered the download with something that isn't a .torrent file.
download.elsewhere: The release's download link points somewhere other than the Torznab feed's address, so the app didn't fetch it.
download.key-missing: The release's download link needs the Torznab feed's API key, and none is saved for the feed. Enter its API key.
download.not-found: The Torznab feed couldn't hand over this release (404 Not Found): it may be gone, or the feed failed to fetch it; its own log says which.
download.gone: The Torznab feed can't hand over this release any more ({{error, message}}). Search again.
download.gone-status: The Torznab feed can't hand over this release any more ({{status}}). Search again.
download.failed: The Torznab feed failed to hand over the release ({{error, message}}).
download.not-understood: The Torznab feed didn't understand the download request ({{error, message}}).
download.redirect-without-target: The Torznab feed answered the download with a redirect that doesn't say where to, and the app doesn't follow redirects.
download.redirect-own-address: The Torznab feed sends this download on to another address of its own at {{origin, vendor}} instead of handing it over, and the app doesn't follow redirects.
download.redirect-elsewhere: The Torznab feed sends this download on to {{origin, vendor}} instead of handing it over, and the app doesn't follow it. Switch off the feed's option to redirect downloads to the tracker.
download.redirect-scheme: The Torznab feed sends this download on to a “{{scheme, vendor}}” link instead of handing it over, and the app doesn't follow it.
